title: SIDESTORY: PATH OF LIFE RERUN OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: PATH OF LIFE RERUN OPEN
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Path of Life event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Deploy Beacons] & [Fortify Defense]
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Conundra of the Sophontheatrum]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Underflow], Abyssal Hunter Lab (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip, etc.
[Materianomicon Moderatrix]
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips by clearing event stages and completing [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] missions. 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips can be used to redeem items from [Materianomicon Moderatrix].
REWARDS: Underflow's token, Abyssal Hunter Lab (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Ulpianus, Lucilla, and Underflow will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on December 11, 2025, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – ANCHOR IN THE DEEP
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Anchor In The Deep], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Ulpianus
★★★★★: Lucilla / Sand Reckoner
Note:

This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Laminar Flow for Underflow
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - I Am the Tides for Gladiia
EPOQUE Collection - Scribing for Penance
EPOQUE Collection - For the Banquet for Melanite
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – ABYSSAL HUNTER LAB
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Path of Life event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: November 27, 2025, 08:00 – December 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
